items: 【2K Ultra HD and Full Color Night Vision】Worried that your security camera turns into a useless blur at night? TIEJUS security cameras wireless outdoor and Full-Color Night Vision deliver vivid, 2K-resolution video even in total darkness. Clearly see facial features, clothing colors, and identifying details not just grayscale shadows. Perfect for identifying a late-night delivery person at your front door or monitoring suspicious activity in the backyard.

【3-Day Cloud & Local SD Card & Easy Setup】Worried about monthly fees or complicated setups for your security camera? Get 3 days of loop recording cloud storage permanently—no subscription ever required.For added privacy and endless recording, simply insert a microSD card (supports up to 256GB, not included) for local storage. Install anywhere in under 3 minutes with the included mount.

【Dual-band Wi-Fi and Two-way Voice】Need crystal-clear, real-time communication to protect your home from anywhere? Dual-band 2.4GHz & 5GHz Wi-Fi support ensures a strong, stable connection for uninterrupted live view. Use the built-in two-way audio to speak directly through the camera deter intruders or talk to visitors in real time. Get instant alerts and take immediate action, whether you are at work or on vacation.

【Rechargeable & Solar-Powered for Eco-Security】Tired of constantly climbing ladders to charge or replace camera batteries? The Solar camera outdoor wireless have high-efficiency solar panel provides perpetual power with just 1.5 hours of daily sunlight. A sustainable, energy-saving design that reduces your carbon emissions.

【Wireless and IP66 Waterproof】Dread the idea of drilling holes, running wires, or hiring anelectrician? Renter-friendly with no complex wiring. The outdoor camera is IP66 waterproof & dustproof rating withstands heavy rain and works in extreme temperatures from -4°F to 140°F.

【AI Motion Detection & Instant Smart Alerts】Frustrated by false alarms every time a cat walks by or headlights shine? this surveillance & security cameras has advanced AI Human Detection accurately distinguishes people from animals, vehicles, and swaying branches. When intruders and thieves appear, it actively triggers a siren and white warning light to scare them away effectively. Customize detection zones and sensitivity in the app to receive only the alerts that matter.
